data.title: What's unique about Gecko Robotics' contracts with Nvidia & the US Navy: CEO
data.description: Gecko Robotics CEO, Jake Loosararian, sits down with Yahoo Finance Senior Reporter Brooke DiPalma to discuss the company's expansion and how its contracts with the US Navy and Nvidia (NVDA) factor in.
